definitions.gloss: woolen fabric; wool textile; woolen goods
definitions.explanation: Fabric or textiles woven from wool yarn. Includes various types of wool cloth used for clothing, blankets, and other products.

examples.japanese: {毛織物|けおりもの}は{暖|あたた}かい。
この{地方|ちほう}は{毛織物|けおりもの}の{産地|さんち}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This region is famous as a production area for wool textiles.

examples.japanese: {高品質|こうひんしつ}な{毛織物|けおりもの}を{使|つか}ったコートは{何年|なんねん}も{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: A coat made from high-quality wool fabric lasts for many years.

notes:
Composed of {毛|け} (hair, wool), {織|おり} (weaving), and {物|もの} (thing, product). Part of a family of textile terms using the {織物|おりもの} (woven fabric) pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毛織物|けおりもの}の{産地|さんち} (wool textile production area)
- {毛織物|けおりもの}{工場|こうじょう} (wool textile factory)
- {上質|じょうしつ}な{毛織物|けおりもの} (fine wool fabric)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毛織物|けおりもの}: woven wool fabric
- {絹織物|きぬおりもの}: silk fabric
- {綿織物|めんおりもの}: cotton fabric
